Lemma
[$L^1$-norm in the second space variable] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0358 ↗ lem:chow-iii-heat-kernel-second-variables-adjoint 1. ch26:26.7\group Heat Kernel Mass

If $C_2=\sup _{\mathcal M\times [0,T]}|Q|$, then \[ e^{-C_2(\tau -v)}\le \int _{\mathcal M}H(x,\tau ;y,v)\, d\mu _{g(v)}(y) \le e^{C_2(\tau -v)}. \]
